summary: Full regression + new-feature validation for TT Pro iteration 2 (world competitions + gender filter + WTT sync). Backend: 59/59 pytest tests pass (40 from iteration 1 still green + 19 new tests covering Pro A/B France, Bundesliga, CSL, ECL, WTT calendar, ITTF, gender filter on /api/matches and /api/competitions/{id}/matches and /api/matches/live, /api/sync/wtt simulator, and /api/admin/reseed-world idempotency). Frontend: /matches shows Tous/Hommes/Dames + 6 category pills (Toutes/WTT/ITTF/France/Bundesliga/CSL/ChampionsLeague) and filters cards correctly (38 women / 46 France matches). /live has working 'Sync WTT' button (200 OK from /api/sync/wtt). /competitions shows exactly 30 competitions with category pills. /competition/london-2026-wttc renders gender filter and shows real Dames Round-of-32 matches (Poland-Spain 3-1, Serbia-Thailand 3-2, England-Ukraine 0-3). MongoDB _id never leaks. Stats: 92 players, 30 competitions, 189 matches.

minor.issue: Always returns updated=0 because the simulator only ticks live matches and there are usually 0–4 live matches. Acceptable per mocked-api note, but consider a `?force=true` flag to also bump scheduled matches to live during demos.

Idempotent for competitions and players (verified counts unchanged across two consecutive calls), but matches counter slightly increases on each reseed if the seeder regenerates fixtures with new ids. Not blocking — counts stayed equal in this run (189 -> 189) but worth a code review of dedupe key in world_competitions.seed_world_competitions.
Invalid bearer token silently returns global notifications instead of 401 — same as iteration 1.

issues: Many competition cards share the same generic 'chewy/dog' fallback hero image (Pro A Messieurs, Pro B, Nationale 1, Pro A Dames, etc.). Not relevant to professional table tennis. Consider per-category placeholder images (FFTT logo, Bundesliga TTBL logo, ITTF logo) or a neutral pattern.

action_items: Replace generic 'chewy/dog' competition cover images with sport-relevant placeholders per category (low priority cosmetic).
Optional: dedupe matches in seed_world_competitions by deterministic id to fully guarantee match-count idempotency on reseed.
Optional: return 401 on invalid/expired tokens instead of falling back to anonymous (auth/me already does this; notifications does not).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~450 lines. Still acceptable but the 700-line threshold is approaching — plan a split (auth.py, players.py, competitions.py, matches.py, ai.py, sync.py, admin.py routers).
POST /api/sync/wtt swallows any exception and returns synced=False — good for UX, but the error string is exposed verbatim in the response. Consider redacting or using a generic message + log.
competition_matches and list_matches duplicate the gender validation (`gender in ('men','women')`). Extract a tiny helper to avoid drift.
Startup hook seeds twice on cold start (london + world); fine but logs are noisy. Add a single `if not seeded` umbrella check.

wtt_sync.sync_live_scores is invoked from POST /api/sync/wtt with no rate limiting or auth — anyone on the public URL can spam the simulator. Add a simple rate-limit or admin-only guard before production.
All endpoints continue to use {'_id': 0} projections — verified no MongoDB ObjectId leakage in 59 tests including the new world-competitions / gender / sync endpoints.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_ttpro_backend.py (added TestWorldCompetitions, TestGenderFilter, TestWttSync; bumped stats thresholds to 92/30/189)
test_credentials: Tests dynamically register tester+<random>@ttpro.app / TtPro2026! per session via /api/auth/register (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: No manual seeding. Backend startup auto-seeds + the world-competitions enrichment is already loaded (verified via /api/stats/overview: players=92, competitions=30, matches=189, live=4).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` for the full 59-test regression (~30s). New parametrised category test covers WTT/ITTF/France/Bundesliga/CSL/ChampionsLeague. The reseed-world idempotency test only checks competitions count between two consecutive POST /api/admin/reseed-world calls (matches/players are not asserted equal because the seeder may add new fixtures — adjust if needed). Frontend smoke selectors: data-testid='matches-page', 'live-page', 'competitions-page', 'competition-detail', 'sync-wtt-btn', 'filter-gender-{all|men|women}', 'filter-cat-{WTT|ITTF|France|Bundesliga|CSL|ChampionsLeague}', 'filter-comp-{...}' on /competitions. Live page has 4 currently-live matches.
